title: DECISION: dual-CID model (raw 0x55 + DAG-CBOR 0x71) is correct for IPLD
description: ipld/codec.rs defines CODEC_RAW=0x55 for article body blobs and CODEC_DAG_CBOR=0x71 for structured IPLD nodes. This is the correct IPLD architecture: raw content for body bytes (preserves exact bytes, content-addressable), DAG-CBOR for structured headers/metadata (linked by CID). The dual-codec model aligns with standard IPFS conventions and Corundum extensibility requirements.
